about: (housekeeping 3: the H batch's even-width rule for rope bridges) a 2-wide rope_bridge over a 16-wide ravine 24 deep, running +z. Before the fix ropeGeom's checkSpan and ropeCells put the deck's extra column along rightOf(dir), so running +z or -x the deck stood one column off the walk that lands it (the route's footprint takes +x / +z). even-width-hk3.test.mjs runs it both ways on both axes (the terrain transposed for x)
